info.title: Formula 1 Dataset with Weather & Tyre Features
info.description:
📊 Overview

This dataset provides a lap-level view of Formula 1 races, enriched by merging multiple sources:

Ergast F1 database (race results, drivers, laps)
FastF1 telemetry and session data
Weather data retrieved via FastF1 APIs

The dataset is designed for machine learning tasks such as lap time prediction, race strategy analysis, and performance modeling.

🔗 Data Sources
Ergast API (historical F1 data)
FastF1 Python library (telemetry + weather)
⚙️ Data Processing

The dataset was created by:

Cleaning and standardizing driver identifiers

Merging datasets on:

year, round, driver, lap

Adding weather features:

Air temperature, track temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind

Engineering tyre and stint features:

Compound, tyre life, fresh tyre, stint
Removing data leakage features (e.g., final race position)
Handling missing values and duplicates

📌 Features

Includes:
Race Info
year, round, circuit name
Driver & Lap Info
lap number, grid position, stint
Tyre Features
compound, tyre life, fresh tyre
Weather Features
track temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind speed/direction

Target

lap time (milliseconds)

🎯 Use Cases

Lap time prediction
Race strategy optimization
Feature importance analysis
Regression benchmarking
Time-series modeling

⚠️ Notes

Some weather data is reconstructed via FastF1 API
Residual temporal dependencies exist (lap sequences)
Dataset is intended for predictive modeling rather than causal inference
